name: Ricardo Alonso
bio:
Ricardo Alonso discovered his passion for motorsport through his father, a mechanic for a local rally team. After completing his degree in statistics, he combined his analytical skills with his love for racing, landing a role as a data analyst for a Formula 3 team. He quickly progressed through the ranks, working for several teams in Europe before making the move to NASCAR.

Ricardo's approach to data analysis is methodical and rigorous. He believes in leveraging data to identify even the smallest advantages. His demanding nature pushes his colleagues to strive for excellence and to never settle for mediocrity. He's known for his ability to translate complex data into actionable insights that help improve car performance and race strategy.

What sets Ricardo apart is his intuitive understanding of racing dynamics. He can often spot patterns and trends that others miss, making him a valuable asset to any team. His deep understanding of both the technical and human aspects of motorsport makes him a truly distinctive data analyst.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed back, receding hairline
physical.description: Ricardo is a man of medium build, with a focused gaze and a serious demeanor.

quirks: Always has a small notebook filled with handwritten notes next to his computer.
Insists on using a specific brand of mechanical keyboard for 'optimal data entry'.
Prefers to analyze data in complete silence and will get visibly annoyed by any distractions.
